[link https://www.figma.com/design/qSdtJ1wbHddNm6ebWvF4ia/?node-id=142-4496] Card/RecentTask: showModel 只有使用者自己選 model 時打開(例 I2V Custom),範本生成不開。(component set description; row note 「AI 生成紀錄 · 使用者自己選 model 時才顯示 model」)

[link https://www.figma.com/design/qSdtJ1wbHddNm6ebWvF4ia/?node-id=142-4496] State table column 「tag」 (the 「+ model」 column): the done card with the model tag 「GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst」 under the name, 「View」 at the right.
[link https://www.figma.com/design/qSdtJ1wbHddNm6ebWvF4ia/?node-id=142-4496] unselect: empty checkbox at the top right, 「View」 (多選中未選).
[link https://www.figma.com/design/qSdtJ1wbHddNm6ebWvF4ia/?node-id=142-4496] select: ticked checkbox, 「View」 (多選中已選).
[link https://www.figma.com/design/qSdtJ1wbHddNm6ebWvF4ia/?node-id=142-4496] downloading: 「processing...」 over the thumbnail, 「9 minutes left ...」 and a progress bar, no button (生成中).
[link https://www.figma.com/design/qSdtJ1wbHddNm6ebWvF4ia/?node-id=142-4496] error: 「Error」 with a caution icon over the thumbnail, button 「Retry」 (失敗).
[link https://www.figma.com/design/qSdtJ1wbHddNm6ebWvF4ia/?node-id=142-4496] nsfw: visibility-off icon over the thumbnail, button 「View Details」 (內容不適當).
[link https://www.figma.com/design/qSdtJ1wbHddNm6ebWvF4ia/?node-id=142-4496] 清單卡:寬 = 螢幕寬 − margin(mobile 16 / tablet 40),高度固定; every Card/RecentTask variant is 120 high; date 填「日期 · 長度」, name 填名稱.
[link https://www.figma.com/design/qSdtJ1wbHddNm6ebWvF4ia/?node-id=142-4496] tag_card style=fill, size=S: 灰色屬性標籤・實心・S 高 20,放縮圖、清單。文字改 label。
